purpose: Resolve prospective execution authority after the V2.8.0 new strategy baseline and prevent stale V2.7.32 First60 activation artifacts from executing a superseded strategy identity.

problem_elimination.delete: Do not recover or reconstruct the missing legacy V2.7.32 strategy runner.
problem_elimination.avoid: Do not append V2.8.x observations into the V2.7.32 First60 candidate ledger.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse V2.7.31 official-universe authority and V2.7.32 append-only/no-backfill semantics where applicable.
problem_elimination.substitute: Use a V2.8.3 hypothesis-specific prospective source ledger before any later confirmatory outcome evaluation.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Reuse frozen PIT, calendar/economic-price and source-integrity rules instead of rebuilding them.
problem_elimination.optimize: Only optimize data capture after source-identity governance is frozen.
